summary: @servicetitan/anvil-css-utilities preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package advertises itself as a CSS utilities library (dist/ ships only utilities.css and its source map), but its package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, chmods it 0755, and uses it via execFileSync to run a bundled sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-expression obfuscated bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`, string-array rotation, hex-named identifiers, large integer/character constant pool) that is only executable under the fetched Bun runtime, evading Node-based inspection. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are shipped at the tarball root but are not listed in package.json `files` (declared as ["dist","readme.md"]), so the install-time execution surface is entirely outside the declared manifest. A CSS-only utilities package has no legitimate need for an alternate language runtime or an obfuscated executable at install time; installing this version runs opaque attacker-controlled code under the invoking user's privileges. The @servicetitan scope is consistent with impersonation or hijack of a legitimate corporate namespace.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
